rationale: The macOS window host emitted its drawable-acquire, submit and present scopes under the "render" trace category, so a trace filtered to the gpu capability showed none of the three spans that actually describe GPU work, and a GPU-time question answered from such a trace read as zero rather than as unmeasured. The change re-categorises gpu_acquire, gpu_submit and gpu_present to "gpu" and adds a lint that keeps the category and span name from drifting apart again. render-assets-and-backends is crossed only by core/view/platform/mac/window_host_mac.mm, and only by the category string on three existing PULP_TRACE_SCOPE_NAMED call sites: no span is added or removed, no renderer, backend, Skia pin, font, asset, fixture, snapshot or threshold moves, and paint behaviour is untouched. Registered as watch-only so the family's coverage stays honest about a change that crossed its selector. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
